text.p: CorVel Corp on Friday said it repurchased an additional 200,000 shares of its common stock and approved the future repurchase of an additional 70,000 shares.
The company had previously repurchased 78,000 shares during the fourth quarter of 1996.
The 200,000 shares were bought Friday at $25.75 each from North Star Universal Inc. North Star now holds 23 percent of CorVel's outstanding stock, or 1,025,000 shares,
"This sale of CorVel stock was necessary to optimize our restructuring of North Star," said Jeff Michael, North Star's president.
During the first quarter of 1997, North Star plans to distribute its position in CorVel together with its two technology companies, Americable Inc and Transition Networks Inc.
The remaining assets of North Star will be merged with Michael Foods Inc, a food processing and distribution company originally founded by North Star.
CorVel had 4,397,000 shares outstanding after the purchase.
